about: Package SKM1 (2026-11-20): skill worth by many methods vs today's price, Maps 0-20 skills. worth / price in budget points (cap-1 (3A + H) x m + S). Measurement only: nothing applied. tools/skm/summary.js

rules.flag: 3+ families and more than half of the families with an estimate 25%+ off the price (of max(price, 1)) the same way, on calibrated values
rules.circular: O-hedonic-*, O-measuredS, O-canon listed, not in the consensus

methods.name: pipeline canon measures
methods.idea: the SKILL2 / pipeline measure (tools/skill_canon) at the number nearest the carriers'; the source of most of today's prices

methods.name: V1 win tempo
methods.idea: mirror match: 20 farm-dogs given the skill vs 20 plain farm-dogs, map fields; gain in a tempo score (a win scores 1 - rounds / 30) / that of a budget point

methods.name: V1 wins only
methods.idea: mirror match: 20 farm-dogs given the skill vs 20 plain farm-dogs, map fields; win-rate gain with draws counted as losses / that of a budget point

methods.name: history: bench-skills-2026-10-30.json
methods.idea: the workbench skill test of 2026-10-30 (bench T2 file of that date; worth rescaled to the 3A + H yardstick, the engine and prices of that day)

methods.name: V1 close fights
methods.idea: mirror match: 20 farm-dogs given the skill vs 20 plain farm-dogs, map fields; only fights whose control game ended within 30% of a bramble's Health

methods.name: history: robust mono test 2026-10-22
methods.idea: robust skill test (random rarity / Wait / Lumber profiles and fields, 2,000 fights a row) of 2026-10-22, BF7 units

methods.name: V1 lopsided fights
methods.idea: mirror match: 20 farm-dogs given the skill vs 20 plain farm-dogs, map fields; only fights whose control game was lopsided (margin over 30%)

methods.name: V1 probability of superiority
methods.idea: mirror match: 20 farm-dogs given the skill vs 20 plain farm-dogs, map fields; how often the skill side ends with the better bramble margin than its control (sign test) / the same for a budget point

methods.name: workbook basic (2026-11-07)
methods.idea: the 2026-11-07 workbook's per-card basic figure on bare stat points and skill terms (ridge)

methods.name: history: bench-skills-2026-10-30-remeasure.json
methods.idea: the workbench re-measure of 2026-10-30 (bench T2 file of that date; worth rescaled to the 3A + H yardstick, the engine and prices of that day)

methods.name: workbook power (2026-11-07)
methods.idea: the 2026-11-07 workbook's per-card power figure on bare stat points and skill terms (ridge)

methods.name: history: bench-skills-2026-10-28.json
methods.idea: the workbench skill test of 2026-10-28 (bench T2 file of that date; worth rescaled to the 3A + H yardstick, the engine and prices of that day)

methods.name: workbook advanced (2026-11-07)
methods.idea: the 2026-11-07 workbook's per-card advanced figure on bare stat points and skill terms (ridge)

methods.name: contribution regression: contribution-2026-10-27.json
methods.idea: BAL6 all-cards regression (2026-10-27); per-copy contribution = a + b x bare stat points + sum of skill terms, worth = term / b (ridge)

methods.name: V1 win rate
methods.idea: mirror match: 20 farm-dogs given the skill vs 20 plain farm-dogs, map fields; win-rate gain / the win-rate gain of a budget point (+1 Attack = 3, +2 Health = 2)

methods.name: contribution regression: bench-contrib-global-b15-2026-11-03-bal15-tempo.json
methods.idea: workbench card contribution at 15-Health brambles (2026-11-03); per-copy contribution = a + b x bare stat points + sum of skill terms, worth = term / b (ridge)

methods.name: designers' slack, every fieldable card
methods.idea: the same over every fieldable card of the game (later maps' designs too)

methods.name: skill-costs measuredS
methods.idea: today's price scaled by the entry's measuredS / value (skill_worth.js measures of 10-19 / 10-21)

methods.name: designers' slack, Maps 0-20 cards
methods.idea: what the card designs leave for skills: N minus the bare stats' (3A + H) x m, shared among each card's skills (ridge), Maps 0-20 cards

methods.name: designers' slack, one-skill cards
methods.idea: median slack of the cards that carry only this skill (no sharing assumption)

methods.name: deckopt pick rate (PRO / BPRO decks)
methods.idea: how often the deck optimiser picks a card (copies in the Maps 0-20 PRO / BPRO decks over the map's list) = a + b x bare stat points + skill terms; worth = term / b

methods.name: contribution regression: bench-contrib-global-2026-10-31-skill2-final.json
methods.idea: workbench card contribution after SKILL2 (2026-10-31), random decks; per-copy contribution = a + b x bare stat points + sum of skill terms, worth = term / b (ridge)
